blocks.en: This article is about the security status attributed to an individual character. For the security level attributed to a star system, see system security.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍的是角色个人的安全等级。关于星系的安全等级，请参阅星系安全等级。

blocks.en: Security status is a measure of how law abiding a capsuleer pilot has been recently. It does not however show how law abiding a pilot may be in the future, or has been in the past.
blocks.zh: 安全等级（Security status）衡量的是一名克隆飞行员近期的守法程度。不过它既不代表这名飞行员将来会不会守法，也不代表他过去是否守法。

blocks.en: Your security status can in theory drop as low as -10 and rise up to a theoretical max of +10, but with a more practical max around +5.0 security status as you no longer gain any security increase from belt, mission and incursion rats after that point.
blocks.zh: 理论上，你的安全等级最低可降到 -10，最高可升到 +10，但实际上限大约在 +5.0，因为超过这个值后，击杀小行星带、任务和入侵中的海盗 NPC 就不再提升安全等级了。

blocks.en: Your personal security status determines how ruling factions react to you in high security space, to the point where they'll send their faction police after you if your security status drops low enough. In addition, your personal faction standing also decides whether the faction navy will hunt you down or not.
blocks.zh: 你的个人安全等级决定了高安空间中各统治势力对你的态度，安全等级低到一定程度时，他们会派出势力警察来追杀你。此外，你个人的势力声望也决定了势力海军是否会追捕你。

blocks.en: In short:
blocks.zh: 简而言之：

en: CONCORD forces deal with criminals.
Faction police forces deal with people who have low security status.
Faction navy forces deal with people who have low faction standing.
zh: 统合部部队负责处理罪犯。
势力警察部队负责处理安全等级低的人。
势力海军部队负责处理势力声望低的人。

blocks.en: Effects of Security status
blocks.zh: 安全等级的影响

blocks.en: You can find a capsuleer's Security Status in the Character: Information window.
blocks.zh: 克隆飞行员的安全等级可以在角色：信息（Character: Information）窗口中查看。

blocks.en: Having too low security status will have effects on your life in high and low security space. Positive security status does not provide much of a benefit, but it both serves as a buffer if the pilot suffers a penalty and any attackers will also suffer (slightly) higher penalties depending on the difference in security status. It does not however provide safety from other immediate consequences of actions resulting in security loss, such as Criminal or Suspect timers.
blocks.zh: 安全等级过低会影响你在高安和低安空间的活动。正的安全等级本身好处不多，但它可以在飞行员受到惩罚时起到缓冲作用，而且攻击你的人也会根据双方安全等级的差值受到（略微）更重的惩罚。不过，它并不能让你免于导致安全等级下降的行为所带来的其他即时后果，例如罪犯或嫌犯计时器。

blocks.en: Low security status
blocks.zh: 低安全等级

blocks.en: Once your security status reaches -0.0 you are flagged as having a low security status to all pilots, often called a "banana" for the default yellow indicator. This tag is only informative as having low security status has no gameplay effects until it reaches -2.0.
blocks.zh: 一旦你的安全等级降到 -0.0，所有飞行员都会看到你被标记为低安全等级，由于默认标识是黄色的，常被称为“香蕉”。这个标记只是提示性的，在安全等级降到 -2.0 之前，低安全等级不会对玩法产生任何影响。

blocks.en: Outlaw
blocks.zh: 不法之徒

blocks.en: Once your security status drops to -5.0 or below (technically -4.95) you become an outlaw, also commonly referred to as "perma flashy".
blocks.zh: 一旦你的安全等级降到 -5.0 或以下（严格来说是 -4.95），你就会成为不法之徒（outlaw），俗称“永久闪烁”（perma flashy）。

blocks.en: It means anyone can attack you at any time without CONCORD interfering, even in high security space. It also means that assisting you would be a suspect offense, even for your own corporation members. That means anyone who needs to assist you would have to turn their safeties partially off to assist (yellow safeties), and in the process temporarily become a suspect for fifteen minutes.
blocks.zh: 这意味着任何人都可以随时攻击你，统合部不会干预，即使在高安空间也是如此。这也意味着协助你属于嫌犯行为，即使是你自己军团的成员也一样。也就是说，任何需要协助你的人都必须把安全设置部分关闭（黄色安全设置）才能协助，并因此暂时成为嫌犯 15 分钟。

blocks.en: Travel restrictions
blocks.zh: 通行限制

blocks.en: Once your security status drops below certain thresholds, the empire faction police will start hunting you when you enter high security system. Any cloaking device fitted to your ship will also be disabled based on the same criteria, so you cannot cloak up to avoid the faction police. You will also not be able to dock while in a ship or tether at a player-owned structure.
blocks.zh: 当你的安全等级低于特定阈值时，帝国势力警察会在你进入高安星系时开始追杀你。按照同样的标准，你舰船上装配的隐形装置也会被禁用，所以你无法靠隐形来躲避势力警察。你也无法驾驶舰船停靠在玩家建筑中或接入其系留。

en: Security status of -2.0 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 1.0 systems.
Security status of -2.5 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 0.9 systems.
Security status of -3.0 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 0.8 systems.
Security status of -3.5 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 0.7 systems.
Security status of -4.0 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 0.6 systems.
Security status of -4.5 or below means you'll be attacked in █ 0.5 systems.
zh: 安全等级 -2.0 或以下：在 █ 1.0 星系会遭到攻击。
安全等级 -2.5 或以下：在 █ 0.9 星系会遭到攻击。
安全等级 -3.0 或以下：在 █ 0.8 星系会遭到攻击。
安全等级 -3.5 或以下：在 █ 0.7 星系会遭到攻击。
安全等级 -4.0 或以下：在 █ 0.6 星系会遭到攻击。
安全等级 -4.5 或以下：在 █ 0.5 星系会遭到攻击。

blocks.en: You'll have a few seconds before they arrive and while the faction police is formidable, they are not as strong as CONCORD and can sometimes be handled and often avoided if you're flying a reasonably agile ship. Players with negative ratings can fly through all systems in a capsule, commonly referred to as a "pod", as faction police will not attack pods. But if you're an outlaw, anyone can target and destroy your pod without repercussion ... assuming they can catch you.
blocks.zh: 在他们到达之前你会有几秒钟时间。势力警察虽然很强，但没有统合部那么强，如果你驾驶的是比较灵活的舰船，有时可以与之周旋，而且通常能够躲开。安全等级为负的玩家可以乘坐太空舱（俗称“蛋”，pod）穿越所有星系，因为势力警察不会攻击太空舱。但如果你是不法之徒，任何人都可以锁定并击毁你的太空舱而不会受到惩罚……前提是他们抓得到你。

blocks.en: You will be allowed to dock in high security station or player-owned structure while in your capsule and can undock with a ship, but as soon as you undock you will not be able to dock again while in the ship.
blocks.zh: 你乘坐太空舱时可以停靠高安空间站或玩家建筑，也可以驾驶舰船离站，但一旦离站，驾驶该舰船时就无法再次停靠。

blocks.en: In CONCORD-claimed systems (like the majority of the Sanctum constellation in the Genesis region) the faction police will show up wearing CONCORD colour, but they are not overpowered like the regular CONCORD police is. The CONCORD faction police are no stronger than any other faction police and can be dealt with just as you would any of the others.
blocks.zh: 在统合部宣称主权的星系（例如吉勒西斯星域中 Sanctum 星座的大部分星系），势力警察会以统合部的涂装出现，但他们并不像常规统合部警察那样强得离谱。统合部的势力警察并不比其他势力警察更强，可以用对付其他势力警察的方式来应对。

blocks.en: Changing security status
blocks.zh: 改变安全等级

blocks.en: There are many ways to both gain and lose security status. Bear in mind that with your safety set to enable safety, often referred to as "green" safety, you'll be unable to do any actions that would cause you to lose security status.
blocks.zh: 提升和降低安全等级的途径有很多。请记住，如果你的安全设置为启用安全（俗称“绿色”安全设置），你将无法进行任何会导致安全等级下降的行为。

blocks.en: Losing security status
blocks.zh: 降低安全等级

blocks.en: There are several ways to lose your security status, all concerning unprovoked attacks in low and high security space.
blocks.zh: 降低安全等级的方式有几种，都与在低安和高安空间中的无故攻击有关。

en: Unprovoked attack of a capsuleer ship (small hit)
zh: 无故攻击克隆飞行员的舰船（小幅下降）

blocks.en: Modification%=−2.5%×System security×(1+Target's security−Aggressor's security100)
blocks.zh: 变化%=−2.5%×星系安全等级×(1+目标的安全等级−攻击者的安全等级100)

en: Unprovoked attack of a capsule (major hit)
zh: 无故攻击太空舱（大幅下降）

blocks.en: Modification%=−25%×System security×(1+Target's security−Aggressor's security100)
blocks.zh: 变化%=−25%×星系安全等级×(1+目标的安全等级−攻击者的安全等级100)

blocks.en: In both cases the new security status is calculated as
blocks.zh: 两种情况下，新的安全等级都按以下公式计算：

blocks.en: Aggressor's new security status=Aggressor's old security status+(10−Aggressor's old security status)×Modification%
blocks.zh: 攻击者的新安全等级=攻击者的旧安全等级+(10−攻击者的旧安全等级)×变化%

blocks.en: Unprovoked actions are actions not sanctioned through war, limited engagements, suspect or criminal timers. For example, engaging a non-suspect or non-criminal in low security space that you are not at war with, suicide ganking in high security space. In null security and wormhole space everything is legal so actions there have no effect on security status.
blocks.zh: 无故行为是指不在战争、有限交战、嫌犯或罪犯计时器许可范围内的行为。例如，在低安空间攻击与你没有处于战争状态、也不是嫌犯或罪犯的人，或在高安空间进行自杀式攻击。在 00 区和虫洞空间一切行为都是合法的，因此在那里的行为不会影响安全等级。

blocks.en: While both system security and the relative difference in security status of the aggressor and victim are factored in, the system security difference has a much bigger impact than the relative security status. The higher the aggressor's security standing is, the harsher the penalty as well.
blocks.zh: 虽然星系安全等级和攻击者与受害者之间的安全等级差值都会计入，但星系安全等级的影响远大于双方安全等级的差值。攻击者的安全等级越高，惩罚也越重。

blocks.en: Remember that these actions always lead to you getting either a suspect or a criminal timer, depending on which action you chose to engage in and the security level of the system you're in. Not all suspect or criminal offenses will result in a security status hit however. Stealing from a can will flag you as a suspect, but you won't lose any security status. Criminal acts in low security space doesn't incur the wrath of CONCORD unless you decide to jump into high security space before your criminal timer runs out.
blocks.zh: 请记住，根据你采取的行为和所在星系的安全等级，这些行为总会让你获得嫌犯或罪犯计时器。但并非所有嫌犯或罪犯行为都会降低安全等级。从货柜中偷东西会让你被标记为嫌犯，但不会损失安全等级。在低安空间的犯罪行为不会招致统合部的打击，除非你在罪犯计时器结束前跳进高安空间。

blocks.en: Raising security status
blocks.zh: 提升安全等级

blocks.en: Main article: Repairing security status
blocks.zh: 主条目：修复安全等级

blocks.en: There are numerous activities that raise your security standing.
blocks.zh: 有很多活动可以提升你的安全等级。

en: Running missions against pirate factions (you gain security status from the high bounty rats).
Killing high bounty belt rats, a.k.a. belt ratting, in low and null security space (the larger the rat, the higher the increase).
Running Incursions (requires that you have at least aggressed the Sansha rats).
Turning in security tags to CONCORD in low security space.
Completing various social skills.
zh: 执行针对海盗势力的任务（击杀高赏金的海盗 NPC 可获得安全等级）。
在低安和 00 区击杀高赏金的小行星带海盗，即在小行星带刷怪（海盗 NPC 越大，提升越多）。
参加入侵（至少要对萨沙 NPC 发起过攻击）。
在低安空间向统合部上交安全标签。
完成各种社会学技能。

blocks.en: Security increase through killing NPCs such as mission, belt and incursion rats can only give you a security increase up until your security status reaches +5.0, then no further gain by this method is possible. Security tags are limited to removing negative status and cannot improve your status further once you reach 0.0 or higher.
blocks.zh: 通过击杀任务、小行星带和入侵中的海盗 NPC 等方式提升安全等级，只能提升到 +5.0，之后就无法再通过这种方式继续提升。安全标签只能消除负的安全等级，一旦你的安全等级达到 0.0 或更高，就无法再用它继续提升。

blocks.en: Sentry guns
blocks.zh: 岗哨炮

blocks.en: Whenever you lose security status through suspect or criminal offenses in low or high security space, any sentry gun on grid will engage you. The sentry guns will continue engaging you for as long as you remain on grid.
blocks.zh: 每当你在低安或高安空间因嫌犯或罪犯行为而降低安全等级时，同一网格内的所有岗哨炮都会攻击你。只要你还留在该网格内，岗哨炮就会持续攻击。

blocks.en: No aggression is carried over after leaving the grid where you performed your initial act, so even though you're still a suspect or a criminal there's no further aggression from those or other sentry guns once you warp off-grid. Just remember that a new act of aggression that causes you to lose more of your security status, such as continuing to pod someone in low security space after initial aggression, would trigger another response from present sentry guns. But they too can easily be reset by bouncing to an off-grid tactical and back.
blocks.zh: 离开你最初实施行为的网格后，仇恨不会延续，所以即使你仍然是嫌犯或罪犯，只要跃迁离开该网格，那些岗哨炮或其他岗哨炮都不会再攻击你。但要记住，任何会让你进一步损失安全等级的新攻击行为（例如在低安空间初次攻击后继续击毁某人的太空舱），都会再次触发现场岗哨炮的反应。不过同样只需跃迁到网格外的战术点再回来，就能轻松重置它们。

Amarr Sentry Caldari Sentry Gallente Sentry Minmatar Sentry (identical stats)
zh: 岗哨炮

176 dps（2.5 秒循环） 500km 最佳射程 + 50km 失准范围 160 rad/s 跟踪速度
艾玛岗哨炮 加达里岗哨炮 盖伦特岗哨炮 米玛塔尔岗哨炮（属性完全相同）

blocks.en: All sentry guns are invulnerable and you can't even lock them up, "Target is invulnerable".
blocks.zh: 所有岗哨炮都是无敌的，你甚至无法锁定它们（“目标无敌”）。
